notes.subject: כחללים
notes.rationale: Hap tok: ol man i dans (root חול, go raun) o ol man i ploya long instrument; KJV 'players on instruments', JPS 'dance'.

notes.subject: בך
notes.rationale: Tok i go long Tsiyon/Yahwe — yu.

translation: Na ol singsing man, wankain olsem ol man i go raun wokim dans: olgeta ples wara i bruk i kamap bilong mi, ol i stap long yu.
